'''Likkas''' were long-legged crocodilians native to [[Abonshee|Masterhome]]. They were [[Color/Legends|greenish-brown]] and had brilliant yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. They stood 1.5 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall at the shoulder and grew 3 meters long. They were ill-tempered and had powerful bites. The [[Anointed People]] rode on them, attaching reins to their eyelids.<ref name="CP" />
